cohort: Five current-runtime runs under runs/seed_1340 through runs/seed_1344; archived seed 1340 is excluded

uncertainty.sd: Sample SD across independent seed-level measurements (ddof=1)
uncertainty.ci95: Student-t interval for the seed mean, df=n-1
uncertainty.one_seed: SD, SEM and confidence limits are null when n=1
uncertainty.spectral_weights: Fit-quality weights are not confidence intervals
uncertainty.paired_differences: Current modified AdamW minus historical native AdamW, matched by seed label and budget; accuracy differences are percentage points. These are descriptive cross-runtime comparisons, not isolated optimizer effects.

historical_seed1340.interpretation: Single matched-seed runtime replay; no sampling uncertainty, equivalence, or causal inference is assigned
